children: Egyptian developer Eldiwan Real Estate Development plans to launch a residential project in Ras El Hekma on the North Coast within the next few weeks, with an estimated investment of 1.6 billion Egyptian pounds ($29.42 million).
Chairman Osama Gomaa told Zawya Projects that the development will span 49,000 square metres (sqm) and comprise 400 residential units.
Construction is expected to begin approximately three months after the launch, with completion and handover scheduled within three years, he said.
(Reporting by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
